from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStatsRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly housing statistics data point extracted from a document."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The data month in YYYY-MM format")
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The document release date in YYYY-MM-DD format to establish precedence")
    permits_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Building Permits")
    starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")
    completions_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Completions")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_stats_records: list[HousingStatsRecord]
